instructions:
NuMetric MCP — read-only access to a NuMetric.work account (POS/ERP/accounting).

TENANCY: one connected account can hold SEVERAL businesses, and every data tool acts on the one currently ACTIVE. You never pass a businessId as a tool argument. Instead: call list_businesses to see the account's businesses, then select_business (by id or company name) to choose one; the choice sticks for the session and can be switched anytime. If no business is selected yet, data tools return NO_BUSINESS_SELECTED — pick one first. When the account has exactly one business it is auto-selected. Read numetric://business/profile for the active business (or the list, when none is selected). Note: read scopes are per-business, so switching businesses can change what you're permitted to read.

READS are safe and free to call. Many results carry a "confidence" field — "Verified" means the figure is cross-checked/live; "Guarded" means it may be stale or divergent, so report it as unconfirmed and do NOT assert it as fact. Notably: get_receivables cross-checks status-based vs aging overdue totals; get_financial_statement profit_loss/balance_sheet are snapshot-sourced (Guarded) while trial_balance is live (Verified); get_kpis returns per-KPI confidence and inputs. Tools you lack permission for return a SCOPE_REQUIRED error — your granted read scopes reflect your NuMetric permissions.

SOURCE OF TRUTH: NuMetric's accounting engine is authoritative — it is the single source of truth for every figure these tools return (account balances, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPIs). Those figures are computed by NuMetric's ledger and handed to you ready-made: you never need to reconstruct accounting logic, and you must NOT re-derive totals from raw transactions or replace an engine figure with your own recomputation. Report the engine's numbers as its findings. You may think, analyse, and interpret on top of them — but your own accounting reasoning must not conflict with, contradict, or silently override those findings. If your calculation disagrees with an engine figure, treat the engine as correct and surface the discrepancy as a question, not a correction. (A "Guarded" figure is unconfirmed — flag it as such, but still do not overwrite it with your own math.)

This server exposes read tools only. It cannot record payments, approve invoices, create/update documents, or delete anything — there are no write tools to call.

DATA QUALITY: list_customers flags duplicate/guest-fragmented records; surface those caveats rather than treating counts as clean.

tools.name: get_account_transactions_report
tools.title: Account transactions report
tools.description: Period account-movement report (the "new" account transactions report): per-account debit/credit/balance for the period, PLUS opening balances, income/expense, and retained sections. periodType groups the reporting period (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/QUARTERLY/YEARLY). Built on the same engine trial-balance endpoint (Verified) — richer than get_financial_statement trial_balance, which returns only the account movements. Read-only.

tools.name: get_asset_custody_report
tools.title: Asset custody report
tools.description: Fixed assets organized by CUSTODIAN (who holds them): each asset with its holder, location, and current value, plus a per-custodian roll-up (asset count + total purchase/net-book value). Filter by assignedToUserId and/or location. Depreciation/net book value are NuMetric-computed as-of today (Verified). Read-only.

assignedToUserId.description: Filter to one custodian (the user an asset is assigned to).

tools.name: get_asset_report
tools.title: Fixed-asset (depreciation) report
tools.description: Fixed-asset register with depreciation: per asset — name, type, serial, status, assignee, location, purchase date/value, depreciation %, accumulated depreciation, period depreciation, and net book value — plus totals. Optional filters: isAuto (auto-depreciation only), assetAccountId (fixed-asset account), assignedToUserId, location. NuMetric-computed depreciation (Verified) — do not re-derive. Read-only.

endDate.description: Period end / as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today).

isAuto.description: Limit to assets with automatic depreciation.

assetAccountId.description: Filter by the fixed-asset account id (from list_chart_of_accounts).

assignedToUserId.description: Filter by the user an asset is assigned to.

tools.name: get_bill_status
tools.title: Get bill status
tools.description: AP status of one vendor bill (status, due date, due amount, total). Pass billId, or billNumber (resolved from the bill list). Read-only.

billNumber.description: Human bill number (resolved to an id).

tools.name: get_cash_position
tools.title: Cash & bank position
tools.description: Current combined cash and bank balance for the connected business. Read-only.

tools.name: get_cashier_attendance
tools.title: Cashier attendance report
tools.description: Login-session attendance for one cashier over a date range: per-day login/logout times and duration. Requires cashierEmail (the cashier's login email — the report is per cashier). Login-session timing, not POS-terminal clock-in/out. NuMetric-sourced (Verified). Read-only.

cashierEmail.description: The cashier's login email. Required — the report resolves the user by email.

tools.name: get_cashier_sales_invoices
tools.title: Cashier sales — invoices
tools.description: One cashier's invoices over a date range (invoice-list view): per invoice — number, customer, dates, order source, POS/cash flags, subtotal/tax/discount/total/due, item count, and status — plus totals. Requires cashierEmail. Same underlying sales as get_cashier_sales_items (which aggregates by product instead). NuMetric-sourced (Verified). Read-only.

cashierEmail.description: The cashier's login email. Required — the report resolves the cashier by email.

tools.name: get_cashier_sales_items
tools.title: Cashier sales — items
tools.description: Units sold per product across ONE cashier's invoices over a date range: per product — quantity (units), gross line amount (price × qty, before invoice-level discounts/tax), and invoice count. Requires cashierEmail (the report is per cashier). The per-product roll-up is computed from the engine's invoice line items (stated in notes). Read-only.

cashierEmail.description: The cashier's login email. Required — the report resolves the cashier by email.

tools.name: get_daily_transactions
tools.title: Daily transactions report
tools.description: General-journal listing over a date range: one row per double-entry line — date, serial number, transaction number, description, category (Invoice/COGS/…), type, account, debit, credit — plus engine debit/credit totals and a balanced check. Rows sharing serialNumber belong to one transaction. NuMetric-computed (Verified). Read-only.

tools.name: get_document
tools.title: Download document content
tools.description: Download one document's content as base64, with metadata (file name, type, size). Requires fileId (from list_documents). NOTE: content is returned INLINE as base64 — large files consume a lot of context, so files over maxBytes (default 5 MB) return metadata only (contentReturned:false); raise maxBytes to force. Read-only.

fileId.description: The document fileId to download (from list_documents).

maxBytes.description: Max file size to inline as base64 (default 5,000,000; capped at 25,000,000). Larger files return metadata only.

tools.name: get_document_bundle
tools.title: Download all documents on a record (ZIP)
tools.description: Download a ZIP of ALL documents attached to one record (invoice/bill/JV/product/…) as base64, with size. Requires referenceId (from list_documents — the record the files are attached to). Same size guard as get_document (default 5 MB → metadata only above it). Read-only.

referenceId.description: The record id whose attached documents to bundle (referenceId from list_documents).

maxBytes.description: Max zip size to inline as base64 (default 5,000,000; capped at 25,000,000).

tools.name: get_financial_statement
tools.title: Financial statement
tools.description: Accrual-basis financial statement: statement = "profit_loss" (account-based income/expense + net profit), "balance_sheet" (assets/liabilities/equity as of endDate), "trial_balance" (per-account debit/credit/balance), "general_ledger" (per-account transaction detail with running balance — requires accountId), or "cash_flow" (monthly net cash in/out + net change for the year of endDate). Each carries a Verified/Guarded confidence. Read-only.

startDate.description: Inclusive period start, YYYY-MM-DD (ignored for balance_sheet).

endDate.description: Inclusive period end / as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD.

accountId.description: Required for general_ledger: the account whose ledger to return (get ids from list_chart_of_accounts).

tools.name: get_invoice_source_report
tools.title: Invoice source report
tools.description: Non-draft invoices over a date range, filterable by SOURCE: orderFrom (e.g. "POS-Order"), customer, project, invoiceScope (local/export), invoiceKind (cash/regular). Each invoice carries customer, dates, order source, amounts (subtotal/tax/shipping/total/due), COGS, and status. Returns per-page sums and pagination. NuMetric-computed (Verified). Read-only.

customerId.description: Filter to one customer (id from list_customers).

projectId.description: Filter to one project (id from list_projects).

tools.name: get_invoice_status
tools.title: Get invoice status
tools.description: AR status of one invoice (primary/secondary status, due date, due amount, total). Pass invoiceId, or invoiceNumber (resolved from the invoice list). Read-only.

invoiceNumber.description: Human invoice number, e.g. "INV2026-00006" (resolved to an id).

tools.name: get_item_summary
tools.title: Item summary (stock card)
tools.description: Per-item stock-movement ledger over a date range: each movement — date, transaction type (Sales Invoice/Purchase/…), signed quantity, running closing stock, price, reference number — plus the item name and ending stock. Requires itemId (from list_products). NuMetric-computed (Verified). Read-only.

itemId.description: The item/product id whose stock movements to return (from list_products).

tools.name: get_kpis
tools.title: Financial KPIs
tools.description: First-class accounting KPIs for a period: cash runway, current ratio, DSO, DPO, revenue concentration, and unreviewed-transaction count. Each returns its value, raw inputs, and a "confidence" (Verified/Guarded) — hedge on any Guarded figure. Note: NuMetric tracks "reviewed" (not bank "reconciled") status. KPIs the caller lacks scope for return value:null with a note. Read-only.

kpis.description: Subset of KPIs to compute; omit for all.

tools.name: get_multi_project_profit_loss
tools.title: Multi-project P&L
tools.description: Profit & loss broken down PER PROJECT for the given projects over a date range: NuMetric-computed income, expense, and net profit per project, plus a combined total across them. Get project ids from list_projects. Figures are computed by the accounting engine (Verified) — do not re-derive them. Read-only.

projectIds.description: One or more project ids to break the P&L down by (from list_projects).

tools.name: get_payables
tools.title: Payables (aging)
tools.description: Money we owe: payables aging buckets (firstPhase = current → lastPhase = oldest) with a total. Read-only.

tools.name: get_receivables
tools.title: Receivables (aging + overdue confidence)
tools.description: Money owed to us: aging buckets (firstPhase = current → lastPhase = oldest) plus an overdue summary that cross-checks status-based vs due-date aging and returns a "Verified" or "Guarded" confidence. Treat a Guarded overdue figure as unconfirmed. Read-only.

tools.name: get_sales_tax
tools.title: Sales tax (VAT) report
tools.description: Sales-tax / VAT report for a date range: output VAT (tax collected on sales) and input VAT (tax paid on purchases), per tax account, with taxable bases, tax totals, and the net tax payable (output − input). All figures are NuMetric-computed (Verified) — do not re-derive them. Read-only.

tools.name: get_sales_tax_transactions
tools.title: Sales tax transaction detail
tools.description: Per-transaction sales-tax (VAT) detail for ONE tax account over a date range: each invoice/bill with its net amount, tax amount, and total. Requires accountId — the tax account id (get it from list_chart_of_accounts). Each row's type is "Invoice" (output VAT) or "Bill" (input VAT). NuMetric-computed (Verified) — do not re-derive. Read-only.

accountId.description: The tax account id to report on (from list_chart_of_accounts). Required — the report is per tax account.

tools.name: get_source_quantity_report
tools.title: Source quantity report
tools.description: Units sold per product across non-draft invoices in a date range, filterable by source (orderFrom, customer, project, invoiceScope local/export, invoiceKind cash/regular). Per product: quantity (units), gross line amount (price × qty, before invoice-level discounts/tax), and invoice count. Quantities roll up the engine's invoice line items (NuMetric has no dedicated endpoint for this) — the roll-up is computed here, stated in notes. Read-only.

customerId.description: Filter to one customer (id from list_customers).

projectId.description: Filter to one project (id from list_projects).

tools.name: get_storage_overview
tools.title: Document storage overview
tools.description: The auto-categorized document tree (parentType → documentType with file counts) plus storage usage (total/used/remaining bytes, total files). Use a category's parentType + documentType with list_documents. Read-only.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction detail
tools.description: Fetch one ledger transaction by id, including its full journal lines and the referenced document. Read-only.

tools.name: list_bills
tools.title: List bills (payables)
tools.description: List vendor bills for the connected business (number, vendor, date, status, total, due). Read-only.

tools.name: list_businesses
tools.title: List businesses
tools.description: List every NuMetric business on the connected account, flagging which one is currently active and which you have read access to. Call this first if no business is selected: every other tool acts on the ACTIVE business, chosen with select_business. Read-only.

tools.name: list_cash_invoices
tools.title: List cash invoices (with filters)
tools.description: List POS cash invoices with optional date range (from/to, YYYY-MM-DD) and exact customer-name filter. Returns a per-customer breakdown + total. Read-only.

tools.name: list_cashiers
tools.title: List cashiers / staff
tools.description: List the business's staff/cashiers — name, login email, id, last login. Use the email as the cashierEmail argument for get_cashier_attendance / get_cashier_sales_items / get_cashier_sales_invoices. Read-only.

tools.name: list_chart_of_accounts
tools.title: Chart of accounts
tools.description: The business chart of accounts (id, name, type, section, current/non-current classification) grouped by section. NOTE: per-account balances are NOT available on the NuMetric API (the trial-balance engine is not deployed) — the balance field is not authoritative. The chart is flat (no hierarchy) and classification is heuristic (confidence: Guarded). Read-only.

startDate.description: Period start, YYYY-MM-DD (reserved for when balances become available).

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List customers (with duplicate detection)
tools.description: List customers and flag data-quality issues: names mapping to multiple ids (record fragmentation) and guest/walk-in placeholder records. Read-only.

duplicatesOnly.description: If true, omit the full customer list and return only the duplicate groups + counts.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List uploaded documents of one category, grouped by the record they are attached to (invoice/bill/JV/product/…). Each file has name, type, size (bytes), uploader, and date. Requires parentDocType + documentType (from get_storage_overview). Read-only.

parentDocType.description: The parent document category, e.g. "Inventory", "Sales" (from get_storage_overview).

documentType.description: The document type within the category, e.g. "Product", "Invoice" (from get_storage_overview).

tools.name: list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates/quotes for the connected business (number, customer, date, status, total). Read-only.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices for the connected business (merged general + overdue feeds, deduped and normalized). Read-only.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List inventory products with on-hand, reserved, low-stock flag and inventory value. Set lowStockOnly:true to return only products below their reorder threshold. Read-only.

lowStockOnly.description: If true, return only products currently below their low-stock threshold.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: The business's projects (job/cost-centres) — id, name, active flag, description — paginated. Use the project ids with get_multi_project_profit_loss. Read-only.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors/suppliers for the connected business (name, email, phone, balance). Read-only.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.title: Search transactions (ledger)
tools.description: Search the journal ledger. Server-side filters: date range (from+to together, YYYY-MM-DD), type, category, and reviewed status. NOTE: filtering by account, counterparty, or amount is NOT supported by the NuMetric backend — see the returned "clientNote". Read-only.

from.description: Inclusive start date YYYY-MM-DD (must be paired with "to").

to.description: Inclusive end date YYYY-MM-DD (must be paired with "from").

reviewed.description: true = reviewed only, false = unreviewed only, omit = all.

tools.name: select_business
tools.title: Select business
tools.description: Choose which NuMetric business the session acts on, by id or company name (see list_businesses). The choice persists for the session until changed; all subsequent tools use it. Read-only (no data is modified).

business.description: The business id or company name to activate (from list_businesses).
